# Akari product information

Last updated: 2026-08-24

## Summary

Akari is an iPhone health app that turns Apple Health data into a calm, readable daily story. It brings supported vitals, activity, nutrition and goals into one view and adds simple explanations with relatable everyday examples.

Akari is designed to inform without judgment. It does not reduce a person's day to a score and does not use alarmist language to drive engagement.

## Product benefits

### See today clearly

Akari explains the user's day calmly, without scores, judgment or alarm.

### Understand your data

Akari provides simple, science-based explanations with relatable everyday examples.

### See the whole picture

Akari brings supported vitals and nutrition together in one clear view so connections are easier to notice.

## Privacy

Akari requires no account. Apple Health data stays on the user's iPhone.

## Availability

Akari is free during its public beta. iPhone users can join through Apple TestFlight at https://testflight.apple.com/join/wrv4aFVQ.

## Medical scope

Akari helps explain personal health data and patterns. It does not diagnose conditions and does not replace professional medical advice.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Akari?

Akari is an iPhone health app that turns Apple Health data into a calm, readable daily story.

### What health data can I see?

Akari brings supported vitals, activity, nutrition and goals together so users can understand their day in context.

### Does health data leave the iPhone?

No. Akari works without an account, and Apple Health data stays on the user's iPhone.

### How can I try Akari?

Join the free public beta through Apple TestFlight and help shape the app before launch.

## Canonical sources

- Official website: https://joinakari.com/
- Public beta: https://testflight.apple.com/join/wrv4aFVQ
